SoundPad.Title: Music & SFX Sound Pad
SoundPad.PanicTooltip: Instantly stop and fade all playing sounds
SoundPad.ConfirmDeleteBank: Are you sure you want to delete this soundboard bank? All mapped pads in this bank will be lost.
SoundPad.DropHint: Drag & drop sounds here from the Playlist sidebar
SoundPad.RightClickToEdit: Right-click or click gear to configure
SoundPad.PreviewTooltip: Sample / Audition this track privately (players cannot hear this)
SoundPad.AssignSound: Click or drop sound to assign

Config.Title: Configure Sound Pad Slot
Config.Label: Button Label
Config.LabelHint: Display title for the button on the sound pad
Config.ModeToggle: Toggle (Click to start, click to stop)
Config.ModeOneshot: One-Shot (Plays once and stops, ideal for SFX)

SceneSwitcher.Title: Session Scene Switcher
SceneSwitcher.PullPlayersTooltip: Pull all connected players to this scene without activating it
SceneSwitcher.ViewSceneTooltip: Switch GM canvas to view this scene without moving players
SceneSwitcher.ActivateSceneTooltip: Activate this scene globally for the entire world and move players
SceneSwitcher.ConfigureTooltip: Open standard Foundry scene configuration sheet
SceneSwitcher.RemoveTooltip: Remove scene from session list (will not delete the scene)
SceneSwitcher.AddCurrentSceneTooltip: Add whichever scene you are currently viewing to this session list
SceneSwitcher.AddNavigatedTooltip: Add all scenes that are shown in the top navigation bar
SceneSwitcher.ClearAllTooltip: Clear all saved scenes from this session's list
SceneSwitcher.ConfirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear all scenes from this session's quick list? (This will NOT delete any scenes from your world).
SceneSwitcher.NoScenesHint: Drag scenes here from the Scenes directory or use 'Add Current Scene' to populate your session plan.
SceneSwitcher.DropZoneText: Drop scenes here to add them to your session list
SceneSwitcher.CycleLightingTooltip: Cycle lighting: Day (0%) → Dusk (50%) → Night (85%) (Right-click to reverse)
SceneSwitcher.CycleWeatherTooltip: Cycle weather: Clear, Rain, Snow, Fog, Clouds, Cinders (Right-click to reset)

PartyPlacement.Title: Place Party on Scene
PartyPlacement.Tooltip: Click on the scene to muster all party tokens clustered together
PartyPlacement.Banner: Click anywhere on the map to place the party ({count} PCs)
PartyPlacement.NoActors: No party members found to place. Ensure you have PCs in your Party actor or player-owned characters.
PartyPlacement.NoScene: No active scene canvas to place tokens on.

ResourceTracker.Title: Resource & Subsystem Tracker
ResourceTracker.AddTrackerTooltip: Create a new resource, clock, or affliction tracker
ResourceTracker.QuickPresetsTooltip: Instantly create common PF2e resources and subsystem clocks
ResourceTracker.NoTrackersHint: Click 'Add Tracker' or select a preset from the ribbon to begin tracking party supplies, clocks, or diseases.
ResourceTracker.ResetConfirm: Reset this tracker back to its default starting value?
ResourceTracker.DeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this tracker?
ResourceTracker.PostToChatTooltip: Send a formatted summary card of this tracker to game chat

Config.Name: Tracker Name
Config.NamePlaceholder: e.g., Food Supplies, Alert Level, Goblin Pox
Config.DirectionUp: Count Up (0 -> Target, e.g. Victory Points, Alert)
Config.DirectionDown: Count Down (Target -> 0, e.g. Rations, Doom Timer)
Config.IconHint: FontAwesome class (e.g. fa-solid fa-droplet) or Foundry image file path
Config.NotesPlaceholder: Additional notes, cure DC, or rules triggered on completion...
Config.QuickPastePlaceholder: Paste text from monster stat blocks, chat, or PDF (e.g. Ghast Fever; Saving Throw DC 16 Fortitude; Stage 1 carrier... Stage 2 3d8 void...)
Config.PinToWidgetHint: Displays this tracker in a floating overlay on screen for instant access.
Config.VisibleToPlayersHint: When pinned to HUD, allows connected players to see this tracker live on their screen.

ImportModal.Title: Import Affliction from Monster / Chat Text
ImportModal.Hint: Paste any disease, poison, or curse text from a monster stat block, chat message, or PDF. All stages, Save DC, and notes will be extracted automatically.

Reputation.TiersDesc: Hunted (≤-30), Hated (-29 to -15), Disliked (-14 to -5), Ignored (-4 to +4), Liked (+5 to +14), Admired (+15 to +29), Revered (+30 to +50).

Attitude.Hint: Shift attitude using Diplomacy (Make an Impression) or Intimidation (Coerce).
Attitude.MakeWorse: Make attitude worse (e.g. failed diplomacy, insult, coerce failure)
Attitude.MakeBetter: Make attitude better (e.g. successful Make an Impression)

ResourceWidget.Title: Trackers HUD
ResourceWidget.CollapseHint: Double-click to collapse HUD (or drag to move)
ResourceWidget.ExpandHint: Double-click to expand HUD (or drag to move)
ResourceWidget.NoPinned: No trackers currently pinned to HUD.

AutoStopOtherMusic.Name: Auto-Stop Other Music Tracks
AutoStopOtherMusic.Hint: When triggering a music track (loop/toggle), automatically fade out other currently playing music tracks on the sound pad.

DefaultFadeDuration.Name: Default Fade Duration
DefaultFadeDuration.Hint: Default duration in seconds for smooth crossfading between music tracks.

SoundPadOpacity.Name: Sound Pad Opacity
SoundPadOpacity.Hint: Set window opacity percentage so you can see the game canvas underneath.

SceneSwitcherOpacity.Name: Scene Switcher Opacity
SceneSwitcherOpacity.Hint: Set window opacity percentage for the Scene Switcher so you can see the game canvas underneath.

ResourceTrackerOpacity.Name: Resource Tracker Opacity
ResourceTrackerOpacity.Hint: Set window opacity percentage for the Resource Tracker.

SoundPadHotbarMacro.Name: Auto-Sync GM Utilities Macros
SoundPadHotbarMacro.Hint: Automatically creates handy Sound Pad, Scene Switcher, and Resource Tracker macros in the Macro Directory.
